sources.origin: Tesla Q2 2026 production, deliveries and deployments

contradictions: Q2 vehicle deliveries exceeded production by roughly 28,000 units, a favorable near-term inventory signal that also means delivery growth must be separated from current-quarter production growth.

Vehicle deliveries substantially beat compiled expectations while storage was roughly in line; execution strength was therefore uneven across operating vectors rather than uniformly above expectations.
Deliveries beating expectations is real execution evidence, while deliveries exceeding production means part of the quarter's strength came from inventory conversion; both must remain explicit.
Vehicle delivery outperformance and roughly in-line storage execution show uneven strength across Tesla's two major physical scaling vectors.
